title: Show-source disclosure (R) — alternate language
description: Verifies the `sourceLanguage: r` branch of the Show-source disclosure. Ensures the PlotImage widget can carry source code in languages other than Python.

data.markdown:
The `sourceLanguage` field on a PlotImage section accepts `python` or `r`. The widget's read-only CodeMirror panel switches the highlighter accordingly. If `sourceLanguage` is omitted, the widget defaults to `python`.

This lesson exercises the `r` branch using the same gauss1d figure but with an R `ggplot2` snippet that would produce an equivalent plot.

data.alt: 1D Gaussian density centred at zero with sigma=1, rendered with ggplot2
data.caption: Figure 1. The same density rendered with ggplot2 — click "Show source" to view the R reference code.
data.sourceCode:
library(ggplot2)

df <- data.frame(
  x = seq(-4, 4, length.out = 200)
)
mu <- 0
sigma <- 1
df$y <- dnorm(df$x, mean = mu, sd = sigma)

ggplot(df, aes(x = x, y = y)) +
  geom_line(color = "#1f77b4", size = 1) +
  ggtitle(sprintf("1D Gauss, sigma=%g", sigma)) +
  xlab("x") +
  ylab("density") +
  theme_minimal()

ggsave("gauss1d.png", width = 6, height = 4, dpi = 110)
